title: One-word substitution
examples: Can you show me how to turn this long phrase into one word?
Are there any tricky phrases that are hard to shorten?
What is the best way to practice this for a test?

explain.say: Today we are learning to shorten phrases into one word.

items: Phrase: a person who writes books

explain.say: For example, instead of saying 'a place where books are kept', we can say library.
Another one is 'a sweet drink made from flowers', which we call cordial.
If someone is 'able to be seen', we can use the word visible.
In real life, if you describe a person who is always late, you could say they are tardy.
A common mistake is using a similar word instead of the exact one word substitution.

faq.q: How many words can I substitute into one word?
faq.a: You can substitute several words into one word. This helps make your speaking sound more advanced.
asks: Is it okay to use more than two words?

faq.q: Are these substitutions only for formal writing?
faq.a: No, you can use them in speaking too. It helps you speak more clearly and precisely.
asks: Do I only use this in essays?

faq.q: If I don't know the one word, what should I do?
faq.a: It is okay to use the phrase. Just try to use the one word substitution when you know it.
asks: What if I forget the word?
Should I just use the phrase then?

faq.q: Does the meaning of the word change when I use the single word?
faq.a: No, the meaning stays the same. The single word is just a shorter way to say the same thing.
asks: Is the meaning kept the same?

faq.q: Can I learn more one-word substitutions for science?
faq.a: Yes, there are many for science topics. We can practice those next time.

facts: One-word substitution replaces a phrase with a single word.
This skill improves vocabulary and fluency.
It is useful for making speech sound more concise.
Some substitutions are common in academic writing.

quiz.say: A person who studies stars and planets is called a:
quiz.show: A person who studies stars and planets is called a:
quiz.why: An astronomer is the specific word for someone who studies stars and planets.

wrong.0: An astrologer predicts using stars, which is different from studying them.
wrong.2: This is too general; a scientist studies many things.
wrong.3: A planet is an object, not a person.

quiz.say: What single word means 'a government run by elected people'?
quiz.why: Democracy is the precise term for rule by the people.

wrong.0: A monarchy is ruled by a king or queen.
wrong.1: A republic is a form of government, but democracy is more specific here.
wrong.2: Society is the group of people, not the system of rule.
